Thanks Camila — appreciate the summary. Asha is our procurement lead (copied). A few clarifying Qs: 

- Marketplace: We prefer AWS Marketplace if Redwood can do a Private Offer (so purchasing shows up as a marketplace transaction). Is that supported for Dedicated/reserved capacity or only for hosted API?
- PO vs card: For committed spend we will issue a PO (net-30). For a pilot we could do a card, but procurement prefers to start with a PO if contract value > $50k.
- Contracts & terms: who owns the invoice if we go marketplace private offer? Does AWS invoice us or does Redwood provide net-30 invoices? We need a W-9 and vendor setup docs either way.

Would like to sync procurement + legal (Asha + me) with your team. Thu 10–11am PT or Fri 8–9am PT work for us.

Thanks,

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>

Cc: Asha Raman <asha.r@nebulalabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nebula Labs — procurement & marketplace path (post-demo)

John/Asha — great, thanks for the context. Quick answers from our side:

- Private Offers / Marketplace: We support AWS Marketplace Private Offers for hosted and dedicated models. For Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity) we typically process the booking as a Redwood invoice tied to the private offer; AWS can surface the purchase, but net-30 invoicing to you is supported via Private Offer arrangements or we can accept PO invoicing directly.
- Invoicing & vendor setup: We can provide W-9 and vendor setup docs. For marketplace private offers AWS will still show the purchase through the marketplace, but the payment path can be configured per the private offer (seller-managed invoices are common).
- Timeline: Marketplace listing + private-offer setup typically takes 3–6 weeks depending on paperwork. For PO processing, internal approval timelines are usually the gating factor on buyer side.

I attached a short marketplace-setup-guide that outlines required docs and typical timelines. I’ll loop in Marissa (our contracts lead) to help with T&Cs and the SOW.

Proposed next step: 30-min procurement sync Thu 07/02 at 10:00am PT — does that work?

Camila
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

Attachments: marketplace-setup-guide.pdf (pdf)

Hi John / Asha — quick note from contracts: 

- We can support a standard order form + SOW with our standard Master Services Agreement (MSA). If you require redlines, please provide them in advance of the procurement call so we can triage with Legal.
- For marketplace private offers, we typically do seller-managed invoicing for enterprise deals to allow net-30 terms; we’ll confirm the exact flow for your account and escalate to Marketplace ops if needed.
- Docs we’ll need from you to expedite PO issuance: company legal name, billing address, remit-to contact, and a copy of the PO once it’s issued. If you need our W-9 I’ve attached the vendor packet to the HubSpot deal.

Camila — I’m available on the calendar for Thu 10am PT for the procurement call.
